## Trigger Conditions
This error is returned by the contract when:
- `StreamNotActive` validation fails during entrypoint invocation.


---

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Query the stream status before mutating it; completed or cancelled streams cannot be withdrawn from, topped up, or cancelled again.

---

## Reproduction

The following test code triggers this error condition:

```rust
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
let id = f.create_stream(DEPOSIT, DAY, 10 * DAY, false);
f.client.mock_all_auths().cancel_stream(&f.sender, &id);
rejected!(f.client.mock_all_auths().try_withdraw(&id, &1));
```

This reproduction is derived from the contract's error surface tests in `error_surface_test.rs`.
